fields.name: plan
fields.description: The ordered list of menu letters the demonstration traces, written at the first decision step from the demonstration steps and copied unchanged at every later step. Derive it from the highlighted targets: the first highlighted target at demo t=0 is the start (this start marker may be labelled 'highlighted area' rather than 'highlighted target'; treat it as the first highlighted position all the same, and use its coordinates for the first dy/dx computation); each time a new target becomes highlighted during the demo, take dy = new y minus previous highlighted y and dx = new x minus previous highlighted x (using the coordinates at the first frame each appears). |dy| >= 8 with dy > 0 means forward, dy < 0 means backward; |dx| >= 8 with dx > 0 means left, dx < 0 means right; both over threshold means the diagonal (forward=A, backward=B, left=C, right=D, forward-left=E, forward-right=F, backward-left=G, backward-right=H). One letter per newly highlighted target, in demo order. Write the value as one plain string of bare capital letters in order, with nothing else: no quotes of any kind, no brackets, no commas, no spaces. Position 0 is the first move. The value is compared character by character, so EDGH is right and ["E", "D", "G", "H"] or ['E', 'D', 'G', 'H'] are both wrong. The same form is used at every step of every episode. e.g. EDGH

fields.name: moves_done
fields.description: How many of the planned moves the robot has finished executing by the scene at this step. 0 at the first decision step (nothing executed yet); at every later decision step it is the previous value plus one, since each decision step follows exactly one completed move. e.g. 2
